title: Testing Selective Agents for Ichthyosporeans Abeoforma whisleri, Pirum gemata, and Spaheroforma artica
author: Elena Casacuberta
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.z5nf85e

steps.title: Seed cells in 24-well plates
steps.instruction: Seed Abeoforma whisleri, Pirum gemata, and Spaheroforma artica cells into 24-well plates at a density of 100 cells/well in 500 microliters of medium.

substeps.instruction: Ensure density allows for easy screening of growth and death.
Seed the same density across four or five different dilutions of each drug.
Seed enough wells to maintain 3X replicates for each condition.

steps.title: Add selective agents
steps.instruction: Add the corresponding amount of drug to each well for Abeoforma whisleri, Pirum gemmata, and Sphaeroforma arctica.

steps.title: Maintain and monitor cultures
steps.instruction: Incubate cells and observe for up to one week, refreshing the media and antibiotic every 24 hours.

substeps.instruction: Spin down cells every 24 hours before refreshing media.
If effects on growth are suspected, repeat the experiment with the appropriate drug concentration and count cells every 24 hours.
